chapters.label: The assist, live
chapters.text: Sydney, the 2023 World Cup final, Spain against England. Bronze loses the ball, and Spain break. Ona Batlle finds Mariona Caldentey. Mariona waits... then slips Olga Carmona in. She shoots... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch Mariona
chapters.text: Watch Mariona again. She holds the ball until Carmona runs past on the outside. One clever pass, and Carmona is through!

chapters.label: Into the far corner
chapters.text: From behind the goal: low, past Earps, into the far corner. Spain lead one-nil!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Be patient on the ball. Look up, and before you shoot, look for the pass that splits two defenders.
